Per-sample cell IDs and input files

Source: R/notebook_utils.R
sample_files.Rd

Helpers for merging several samples.

Usage

add_sample_prefix(cell_ids, sample_name)

find_sample_file(data_dir, sample_name, filename)

Arguments

cell_ids

Character vector of cell IDs (coerced with as.character()). NULL is an error.

sample_name

Sample name (a single string).

data_dir

Directory to search.

filename

File name to look for (exact match, case-sensitive).

Value

add_sample_prefix(): a character vector as long as cell_ids. find_sample_file(): the normalised absolute path of the single match.

Details

add_sample_prefix() prepends "<sample_name>-" to cell IDs that do not already start with it, so merged samples get unique cell IDs.

find_sample_file() searches data_dir recursively for a file called filename whose immediate parent directory is exactly sample_name. Files in other directories (e.g. a merge/ output folder) and partial name matches are ignored. It is an error if there is no match or more than one.

Examples

add_sample_prefix(c("AAAC-1", "s1-AAAG-1"), "s1")
#> [1] "s1-AAAC-1" "s1-AAAG-1"

d <- tempfile()
dir.create(file.path(d, "s1"), recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(d, "merge"))
invisible(file.create(file.path(d, "s1", "meta_data.rds"),
                      file.path(d, "merge", "meta_data.rds")))
find_sample_file(d, "s1", "meta_data.rds")
#> [1] "/tmp/Rtmp5rJXej/file19377f014bdb/s1/meta_data.rds"
